purpose: Frozen copy/paste prompts and semantic expectations for checking whether a future agent follows the intended Grade9V3 routing path. These are system stress fixtures, never learner evidence.
rules: Owner knowledge percentage selects a conservative starting coordinate only; it is never mastery evidence.
CORE1A and CORE1B traverse the same canonical rung segment; agency changes, target/depth do not.
Practice support comes from purpose, not from learner percentage.
Missing source basis for source-backed practice must remain an explicit owner input; the agent must not invent source custody.
Prerequisites remain checks/bridges unless evidence demonstrates them.
The agent derives current matrix/library facts from the repository rather than relying on remembered content.
No fixture may create LIVE_LEARNER evidence.

cases.prompt: Prepare CORE1A and CORE1B for Physics — Relative Motion. Student knowledge estimate: 60%. Use it only to select the starting rung and check prerequisites. Use the current canonical matrix/library; do not treat the percentage as mastery evidence.

owner_estimate.instruction: Use 60% only as a conservative starting-coordinate estimate; do not infer mastery.

must_not: choose a different rung for CORE1B

cases.prompt: Prepare CORE1A and CORE1B for Physics — Relative Motion. Student knowledge estimate: 0%. Use it only as the starting-rung estimate; do not infer that any capability is mastered.

owner_estimate.instruction: Use 0% only as a routing coordinate; do not create learner evidence.

must_not: write MISSING mastery evidence from the 0% estimate

cases.prompt: Prepare CORE1A and CORE1B for Physics — Relative Motion. Student knowledge estimate: 100%. Start from the highest conservative matrix coordinate but still check prerequisites; 100% is not proof of mastery.

owner_estimate.instruction: Use 100% as the initial routing coordinate only; prerequisite mastery remains unverified.

must_not: skip prerequisite checks because estimate is 100%

cases.prompt: Prepare CORE1A, CORE1B and CORE2A for Physics — Newton's first law and free-body diagrams. Student knowledge estimate: 70%. CORE2A purpose: PRACTICE. Use the percentage only for starting-rung selection, and do not invent a source basis if one was not supplied.

request.subject: Physics
request.subtopic: Newton's first law and free-body diagrams

owner_estimate.instruction: Use 70% only as a conservative starting coordinate.

cases.prompt: Prepare CORE1A, CORE1B, CORE2A and CORE2B for Physics — Work, energy and power. Student knowledge estimate: 80%. CORE2A purpose: REVISION. CORE2B purpose: COMPETITION. Use the estimate only to choose the initial rung; preserve prerequisite checks and report missing source basis instead of guessing.

owner_estimate.instruction: Use 80% only as an owner routing estimate; do not infer mastery.

must_not: turn CORE2B into CORE2A with fewer hints
